info.title: Communal Platform API
info.description:
API documentation for the Communal platform. This document describes version 2026-03-25.

Optionally send the `X-Api-Version` (or `Api-Version`) header with a supported date version. When omitted, the server uses the default version (2026-08-25). Supported versions: 2026-02-01, 2026-03-25, 2026-08-25.

Version-specific docs: `/docs/api/{version}` (e.g. `/docs/api/2026-03-25`).

get.description:
Paginated facility bookings for the current organization. Members see
their own bookings; managers see all bookings. Nested write, export, and
search routes on this controller stay undocumented.

parameters.name: filter[user_id]
parameters.description: Filter by owning user id. Members are limited to their own bookings regardless of this value.

parameters.name: filter[bookable_entity]
parameters.description: Filter by facility (bookable entity) id(s), including child facilities of a parent. Comma-separated for multiple.

parameters.name: filter[id]
parameters.description: Filter by exact booking id(s), comma-separated.

parameters.name: filter[recurring_id]
parameters.description: Filter by the recurring series id.

parameters.name: filter[uuid]
parameters.description: Filter by exact booking uuid.

parameters.name: filter[starting_at]
parameters.description: Filter to bookings that start on or after this date/time.

parameters.name: filter[ending_at]
parameters.description: Filter to bookings that end on or before this date/time.

parameters.name: filter[query]
parameters.description: Search bookings by owner name or email, facility name, or booking id.

parameters.name: filter[associated_booking_id]
parameters.description: Filter by the parent booking id for linked/child bookings. Pass an empty value to match bookings with no parent.

parameters.name: filter[only_recurring]
parameters.description: When true, only bookings that belong to a recurring series.

parameters.name: filter[tags]
parameters.description: Filter by tag name(s), comma-separated.

parameters.name: filter[with_product]
parameters.description: Filter to bookings associated with the given product id.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: user, guest, bookableEntity, bookableEntity.parent, associatedBooking, organization, bookingItems, tags, formSubmissions, recurringBooking, facilities, bookingContactDetails, products.

parameters.name: append
parameters.description: Append computed attributes (comma-separated). Options include readable_start_time, readable_end_time, owner_name, owner_email, owner_telephone, invoices_paid, total_amount_of_invoices, participants.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Options: id, starting_at, ending_at. Prefix with - for descending.

parameters.name: page[number]
parameters.description: Page number for pagination.

parameters.name: page[size]
parameters.description: Number of results per page.

parameters.description: Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-03-25.

Paginated booking requests for the current tenant. Members see their own

default row is a curated payload (schedule, cost, owner, facility, state).
Pass `include` / `append` for the richer relations the product UI uses.

post.description:
Sends a membership card via the email on file for the user. This method allows
configuration of which card types to send.

This endpoint can also be used to create
and update user specific data that will be used to generate the card. If an email supplied
is not found, a new user will be created with the additional data supplied.
post.summary: Send a membership card for a user

parameters.name: X-Api-Version
parameters.description: Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-03-25.

items.description: By default, all card types ['apple', 'google', 'pdf'] will be used if not specified.

user.description:
User specific data that will stored on the user profile and used to generate the card. If not supplied during
this request, the data stored on the user profile will be used.

unique_identifier_key.description:
The unique identifier key for the user. This is used to identify the user in the system.
In the example below, the unique identifier key is "MemberID".

data.description:
Additional metadata that can be included with the user data.
Example of metadata keys (all in CapitalCase):
```
"MemberID": "123456",
"Active": true,
"LastName": "Smith",
"FirstName": "John",
"MiddleName": "Andrew",
"ExpiryDate": "12/31/2025",
"PreferredEmail": "john@smith.com",
"MemberCardLastUpdatedDateTime": "06/03/2025",
"MemberType": "Active"
```

get.description:
Paginated, filterable, and sortable transaction ledger for reporting and
managed-API-key consumers. Every row is scoped to the current tenant.

parameters.name: filter[range]
parameters.description: Filter to transactions whose effective date falls between two dates. Pass as comma-separated start,end (or an array): filter[range]=2025-01-01,2025-01-31.

parameters.name: filter[starting_at]
parameters.description: Filter to transactions with an effective date on or after this date.

parameters.name: filter[ending_at]
parameters.description: Filter to transactions with an effective date on or before this date (end of day).

parameters.name: filter[type]
parameters.description: Filter by transaction type. Supports comma-separated values. Options: membership, program, charge, invoice, donation, booking, refund, transfer. Each option (other than refund) matches both the charge and its refund type.

parameters.name: filter[query]
parameters.description: Search transactions by related user/guest/account name or email, or by program signup id (subscription schedule lookup).

parameters.name: filter[membership_type_id]
parameters.description: Filter to transactions for the given membership type (plan product) id.

parameters.name: filter[amount]
parameters.description: Filter by amount in dollars. Pass a bare value for an exact match, or prefix with lte: / gte: for a range bound.

parameters.name: filter[id]
parameters.description: Filter by exact transaction id. Supports comma-separated values.

parameters.name: filter[payout_id]
parameters.description: Filter by exact payout id.

parameters.name: filter[subscription_schedule_id]
parameters.description: Filter by the local subscription schedule id (transactions.subscription_schedule_id). This is not the Stripe `sub_sched_...` id, which lives on subscription_schedules.stripe_schedule_id.

parameters.name: filter[user_id]
parameters.description: Filter by exact owning user id.

parameters.name: filter[promotion_code_id]
parameters.description: Filter by exact promotion code id.

parameters.name: filter[tags]
parameters.description: Filter by tag name(s). Supports comma-separated values.

parameters.name: filter[with_product]
parameters.description: Filter to transactions associated with the given product (membership/plan) id. Takes a product id, not a boolean — it matches both transaction line items and invoice items for that product.

parameters.name: filter[with_parent_program]
parameters.description: Filter to transactions associated with the given parent program id(s), including the refunds of those charges. Takes parent program id(s), not a boolean. Supports comma-separated values.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Include related resources (comma-separated). Only these two options visibly change the response; every other loadable relation is already eager-loaded and always present. Options: tags (adds the `tags` field), invoice.bookings.bookableEntity (populates `bookable_entity` inside `invoice.bookings`).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by effective date (falls back to created_at). Options: -created_at (descending) or created_at (ascending).

parameters.name: page[number]
parameters.description: Page number for pagination.

parameters.name: page[size]
parameters.description: Number of results per page.

get.description:
Returns a single transaction, scoped to the current tenant. Relations
are always eager-loaded to match the fields the resource can return
(e.g. invoice, associated_transaction, promotion_code); unlike the
index endpoint, this endpoint does not accept `include` or `append`.
The `tags` field is only ever populated via `include=tags` on the index
endpoint, so it is never present in this response.

parameters.description: Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-03-25.

can_update.description: Whether the current viewer may update this record.

attendance_sheet.description: The attendance sheet this record belongs to.

program_signup.description: The program signup (attendee) this record tracks.

registration_opportunity_ids.description: Registration opportunity identifiers linked to this attendance sheet.

can_update.description: Whether the current viewer may update or delete this sheet.

can_add_person.description: Whether the current viewer may register a person from this sheet.

parentProgram.description: Program this attendance sheet belongs to (derived from first registration opportunity).

registrationOpportunities.description: Registration opportunities this attendance sheet includes.

uuid.description: Public identifier used by guest form links.

can_cancel.description: Whether the owner may still cancel this request.

starting_at_utc_ts.description: Unix timestamp of starting_at in UTC.

owner.description: Resolved booking contact. Prefer this over the raw user/guest/organization relations.

bookable_entity.description:
Facility this request is for. Slim `{id, name}` by default; the full
bookable entity is returned when `include=bookableEntity` is sent.

booking_state.description:
Workflow state. Slim `{id, state_name, color}` by default; the full
state model is returned when `include=bookingState` is sent.

next_state.description:
The state this request advances to next in the facility's workflow.
Present when `append=next_state` is requested; null when the request is already in the final state.

previous_state.description:
The state this request can be moved back to.
Present when `append=previous_state` is requested; null when the request is in the first state.

id.description: The unique identifier of the activity log entry.

request_hash.description: Unique request hash for tracing the request from API call to delivery.

message.description: Human-readable message describing the card delivery event.

delivered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the card was delivered.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp of when the card was delivered.

user_id.description: The ID of the user who received the card.

member_id.description: The member ID of the user who received the card.

obfuscated_emails.description: Array of obfuscated email addresses where the card was sent.

emails_attempted.description: Array of obfuscated email addresses that failed to send.

failure_reason.description: Failure reason if status is failed.

error_message.description: Error message associated with the failure.

id.description: The unique identifier of the facility.

examples: A full-size gymnasium with hardwood flooring and bleacher seating.

type.description:
How bookings are made: `instant` confirms immediately, `request`
needs a manager to approve.

parent_id.description:
The id of the facility this one sits inside, or null when it is
a top-level facility.

capacity.description: The maximum number of people the facility holds.

booking_interval.description: The length in minutes of each bookable slot.

minimum_length.description: The shortest bookable duration, in hours.

maximum_length.description: The longest bookable duration, in hours.

future_days.description: How many days ahead members may book.

basis_time.description: The time of day booking slots are aligned from.

booking_request_deadline.description:
How many hours before the start time a booking request must be
submitted.

booking_instructions.description: Instructions shown to members when they book.
examples: Please arrive 10 minutes before your booking.

user_recurring_bookings.description: Whether members may create repeating bookings themselves.

user_specified_reason.description: Whether members must give a reason when booking.

publicly_exposed.description: Whether the facility's schedule is visible to the public.

publicly_exposed_allow_bookings.description: Whether the public schedule also accepts bookings.

publicly_exposed_hide_user_names.description: Whether the public schedule hides who made each booking.

manager_only.description: Whether only managers may book the facility.

prompt_for_booking_owner.description: Whether the booking form asks who the booking is for.

prompt_for_adding_more_users.description: Whether the booking form asks for additional members to add.

prompt_for_number_of_guests.description: Whether the booking form asks how many guests are attending.

memberships_required.description:
Stripe product ids of the memberships a member must hold to
book, or null when the facility is open to everyone.

membership_requirement_mode.description:
Whether a member needs any one (`or`) or all (`and`) of
`memberships_required`.

status.description: Whether the facility is currently bookable or has been archived.

sort_order.description: Position of the facility in the manually ordered list.

archived_at.description:
ISO 8601 timestamp of when the facility was archived, or null
while it is active.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the facility was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the facility was last changed.

parent.description:
The facility this one sits inside. Included when the `parent`
relation is requested.

children.description:
The sub-facilities inside this one. Included when the `children`
relation is requested.

examples: Carries an EpiPen. No other conditions.
Full access membership with all benefits included.

forced_bundle_with_base.description: When true (add-ons only), the add-on is only offered bundled with its base; the base is not listed alone.

user_blocked_from_membership_checkout.description:
Whether the authenticated member is blocked from purchasing a
membership because their coverage is provided through a family
group holder's membership instead. Only computed on the show
endpoint for an authenticated member; null otherwise (e.g. guests,
or contexts that don't compute this, such as the index listing).

user_can_purchase.description:
Whether the authenticated member can purchase this membership type
according to MembershipTypePolicy::purchase. Only computed on the
show endpoint for authenticated members; null otherwise.

waivers.description: Waivers associated with this membership type.

plans.description: Plans associated with this membership type.

translation_fields.description:
Raw per-locale values and their provenance for the manager translation editor,
plus each field's translation mode (`auto` translates into every supported
locale, `source` shows the English value everywhere). Omitted for non-manager
readers.

examples: Monthly membership plan with full access.

translation_fields.description:
Raw per-locale values and their provenance for the manager translation editor,
plus each field's translation mode (`auto` translates into every supported
locale, `source` shows the English value everywhere). Omitted for non-manager
readers.

title.description: Display name of the program shown to users.

description.description: Detailed description of the program, may contain HTML.
examples: A collection of exciting summer sports programs for all ages.

event_start_date.description: When the program's events begin. All registration opportunities run within this window.

event_end_date.description: When the program's events end. All registration opportunities run within this window.

registration_start_date.description: When registration opens for this program. Users cannot sign up before this date.

registration_end_date.description: When registration closes for this program. Users cannot sign up after this date.

ongoing.description: Whether this is an ongoing program with no fixed end date.

status.description:
Current status of the program (e.g. Active, Archived, Draft, Upcoming,
Ongoing, Past, dates_not_set when no aggregate event window exists).

dates.description: Human-readable formatted event date range for display.

registration_dates.description: Human-readable formatted registration date range for display.

is_event.description: Whether this program represents a single event rather than a series of registration opportunities.

draft.description: Whether this program is in draft mode and not yet published.

is_hidden.description: Whether this program is hidden from public listings.

profile_image.description: URL to the program's profile/header image.

limit.description: Legacy capacity limit alias retained for compatibility with existing clients.

total_spots.description: Total number of signup spots across all registration opportunities.

available_spots.description: Number of remaining spots available to be claimed.

total_signups.description: Total active signups across registration opportunities.

reserved_spots.description: Number of spots reserved by capped registration opportunities.

reserved_spots_signups.description: Number of signups currently consuming reserved spots.

reserved_spots_remaining.description: Remaining reserved spots after reserved signups are counted.

uncapped_spots.description: Number of spots available to uncapped registration opportunities.

uncapped_spots_signups.description: Number of signups currently consuming uncapped spots.

uncapped_spots_remaining.description: Remaining uncapped spots after uncapped signups are counted.

demographic.description: Audience demographic label for this program.

instructor.description: Instructor or facilitator name shown for this program.

location_name.description: Optional display name for the physical location.

location_address.description: Optional street address for the location.

location_latitude.description: Latitude for map display when a location is set.

location_longitude.description: Longitude for map display when a location is set.

is_online.description: Whether the program is delivered online.

readable_event_start_date.description: Human-readable event start date in tenant timezone.

readable_event_end_date.description: Human-readable event end date in tenant timezone.

event_start_time.description: Event start time in tenant timezone (24-hour HH:mm).

event_end_time.description: Event end time in tenant timezone (24-hour HH:mm).

registration_start_time.description: Registration open time in tenant timezone (24-hour HH:mm).

registration_end_time.description: Registration close time in tenant timezone (24-hour HH:mm).

display_only.description: Whether this program is display-only and not intended for signup.

unsplash_author_name.description: Unsplash credit author name for the selected profile image.

unsplash_author_link.description: Unsplash credit URL for the selected profile image author.

multiple_signups.description: Whether users may submit multiple signups for this program.

prompt_for_number_of_guests.description: Whether checkout prompts for number of guests.

prompt_for_registrant.description: Whether checkout prompts for registrant selection.

waitlist_enabled.description: Whether waitlist functionality is enabled for this program.

force_participant_selection.description: Whether participants must be selected before checkout.

show_participant_list.description: Whether participants can view the participant list for this program.

hide_participant_details.description: Whether enrollment counts, participant avatars, and spots remaining are hidden on the program page.

pay_by_cash.description: Whether this program allows cash payment option.

registration_fee.description: Registration fee amount in minor currency units (for example, cents).

cap_registration_fee.description: Whether registration fee is applied once per checkout instead of per signup.

ignores_tax_rates.description: Whether this program is configured to ignore tenant tax rates.

collection_additional_information.description: Whether additional signup form data should be collected.

require_emergency_contact_information.description: Whether emergency contact information is required at signup.

block_facility_calendars.description: Whether facility calendars should be blocked by this program.

auto_archive.description: Whether registration opportunities under this program are automatically archived after their event dates pass.

auto_archive_days.description: Number of days after event_end_date to wait before auto-archiving (0 = immediately).

participant_must_hold_membership.description: Whether the selected participant for a signup must hold the membership that gates the chosen price tier.

form_id.description: Optional linked form identifier for additional questions.

allow_file_uploads.description: Whether registrants are allowed to upload files during signup.

file_uploads_required.description: Whether at least one file upload is required at signup.

file_uploads_max.description: Maximum number of files allowed per signup, or null for default behavior.

volunteer_opportunities_ids.description: Volunteer opportunity identifiers linked to this program.

facility_ids.description: Facility identifiers linked to this program.

sort_order.description: Display order for sorting in listings.

manual_order_enabled.description: Whether this item is pinned in the recommended sort order.

gl_code.description: GL code for accounting/financial reporting on program transactions.

updated_at.description: When this record was last updated.

deleted_at.description: When this record was soft deleted, null if not deleted.

archived_at.description: When this program was archived, null if not archived.

facilities.description: Facilities/locations where this program takes place.

registration_opportunities.description: Registration opportunities available for registration under this program.

member_pricing_savings.description: Best currently available member pricing savings versus guest pricing.

volunteer_opportunities.description: Volunteer opportunities associated with this program.

waiver_assignments.description: Waiver assignments associated with this program.

amount_paid.description:
Gross amount paid for this signup, in cents (principal only,
before refunds). For subscription signups, this is the sum of
installment transactions; for one-off signups, it falls back to
the signup's stored amount_paid.

amount_refunded.description:
Absolute total refunded for this signup, in cents (principal
only). Net paid = amount_paid - amount_refunded.

program_name.description:
Registration opportunity name, selected via join on the list
endpoint so the table can render without including the full
`program` resource. Omitted when the query does not join programs.

parent_program_id.description:
Program ID of the signup's registration opportunity, selected via
join on the list endpoint. Omitted when the query does not join programs.

program_free.description:
Whether the registration opportunity is free, selected via join on
the list endpoint. Omitted when the query does not join programs.

cancelled_at.description: Timestamp set only when the signup was intentionally cancelled.

cancellation_actor.description: Role of the user who intentionally cancelled the signup.

guest.description: Guest associated with this signup (for non-member signups).

additional_member.description: Additional family member registered through this signup.

program.description: Registration opportunity this signup belongs to.

files.description: Files uploaded by the user as part of this signup.

form_submissions.description: Form submissions associated with this signup.

subscription_schedule.description: Recurring subscription schedule for this signup.

attendance_records.description: Attendance records for this signup across all dates.

list_of_activities.description: Comma-separated list of activities from the program.

examples: A fun week-long basketball camp for ages 8-12.

can_manage_registration_opportunity.description: Whether the current viewer may manage this registration opportunity.

min_date_of_birth.description: DOB at the minimum allowed age (youngest participant) — the latest calendar date in the range.

max_date_of_birth.description: DOB at the maximum allowed age (oldest participant) — the earliest calendar date in the range.

member_savings.description: Member discount savings compared to guest pricing.

price_for_user.description: Price for the currently authenticated user based on membership status.

num_signups_remaining_for_user.description: Number of signups remaining for the authenticated user (based on signup limits).

lowest_price_excluded.description: Lowest price available excluding special member pricing.

highest_price.description: Highest price tier available for this registration opportunity.

signup_count.description: Total number of active signups for this registration opportunity.

is_full.description: Whether the registration opportunity has reached its capacity limit.

spots_remaining.description: Number of spots remaining before the registration opportunity is full.

user_signup_count.description: Number of signups the authenticated user has for this registration opportunity.

volunteer_price_is_free.description: Whether the registration opportunity is free for volunteers.

price_id_for_user.description: Stripe price ID applicable for the authenticated user.

required_membership_id_for_user.description:
Stripe product_id the participant must hold for this signup. Populated only when
the program's `participant_must_hold_membership` toggle is on AND the
`participant_membership_enforcement` feature flag is on AND the authenticated user
qualifies for a membership-gated price tier. Null in every other case. Gated by
`?append=...` / `?include=...` like the other computed-for-user fields.

price_recurs_for_user.description: Whether the user's price is a recurring subscription.

price_interval_for_user.description: Billing interval for recurring prices (day, week, month, year).

price_interval_count_for_user.description: Number of intervals between each billing cycle.

can_user_purchase.description: Whether the authenticated user is eligible to purchase this registration opportunity.

required_membership_names.description:
Distinct membership titles that grant access to purchase this registration opportunity.
The field is omitted from the response entirely when the include is not
requested; when requested, it is always an array (possibly empty).

signups.description: Signups registered for this registration opportunity.

parent_program.description: Program this registration opportunity belongs to.

prices.description: Pricing tiers available for this registration opportunity.

waitlist_signups.description: Users on the waitlist for this registration opportunity.

attendance_sheets.description: Attendance sheets for this registration opportunity.

occurrences.description:
Discrete date/time occurrences for this registration opportunity.
Ordered by persisted display position. Admin saves normalize this
chronologically.

recurrence_rule.description:
Recurrence pattern that generated this registration opportunity's occurrences,
when the admin authored the schedule via the recurring builder.
Display metadata only — `occurrences` is the operational source
of truth for queries and registration.

amount.description: Signed integer cents; negative for refunds.

discount_amount.description: original_amount minus amount, in integer cents.

fees.description: Platform + processing fees, in integer cents.

type.description: The integer-backed \App\Enums\TransactionType value. See readable_type for its label.

associated_transaction_id.description: transaction_id of the original charge this transaction refunds, if any.

refund_id.description: The Stripe refund id, if this transaction is a refund.

payment_refund_id.description: The Stripe payment refund id, if applicable.

dispute_transaction_id.description: transaction_id of the disputed charge, if this transaction is a chargeback.

metadata.description:
Curated, whitelisted subset of the transaction's stored metadata. Internal-only
keys (e.g. internal_flag, trigger_tax_receipt) are stripped before serialization.

effective_at.description: The timestamp the transaction is effective as of (used for reporting/sorting).

readable_type.description: Human-readable label for the type enum value.

item_summary.description: Human-readable summary of what was purchased.

net_amount.description: net_amount = amount - fees + tax_amount, in integer cents.

net_fees.description: Fees net of any related refund, in integer cents.

remaining_to_refund.description: Amount still refundable, in integer cents.

has_dispute.description:
Populated by ProgramSignup::transaction() via withExists; falls back to false on
resources loaded outside that relation. Treat null/undefined as "unknown" (do NOT
use as an authoritative gate).

associated_bookings.description: Ids of bookings tied to this transaction's invoice.

associated_booking_requests.description: Ids of booking requests tied to this transaction's invoice.

owner.description:
Minimal owner (frontend only needs email/name/id). Owner may be an
Account, Guest, or Organization, and email is nullable on those.

invoice.description: Minimal invoice with bookings; only present when the `invoice` relation is loaded.

associated_transaction.description:
Minimal associated transaction so refunds can link back to the original charge's
invoice and bookings; only present when the `associatedTransaction` relation is loaded.

promotion_code.description: Promotion code with coupon info; only present when the `promotionCode` relation is loaded.

tags.description:
Tags attached to this transaction. Optional/absent field: only present on the
index endpoint with `include=tags`; the key is entirely absent otherwise,
including on the show endpoint, which does not support `include`.

transaction_line_items.description:
Minimal transaction line items (avoids expensive Program appends); only present when
the `transactionLineItems` relation is loaded. `transaction_line_itemable` is a minimal
id/name pair for the purchased item (e.g. a Program or Product).

id.description: The unique identifier of the user membership.

user_id.description: The id of the member who holds this membership.

status.description:
Current membership state. `retrying` means the last renewal
payment failed and further attempts are scheduled.

will_auto_renew.description:
Whether the membership renews automatically at the end of the
current period.

ends_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the current membership period ends.

renewed_at.description:
ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent renewal, or null if the
membership has never renewed.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the membership was created.

membership_type.description:
The membership type this membership belongs to. Included when
the relation is loaded, which both endpoints always do.

plan.description:
The pricing plan the membership is billed on. Included when the
relation is loaded, which both endpoints always do. `amount` is
in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
